```{r load_scott_rnaseq}
                                               
scott_RNAseq <- 
          read.table("~/Dropbox/GNP_MB_integrate/tss_model/Scott_RNAseq_tss_model_uniq_htseq_counts.txt",
          sep ="\t", 
          header = TRUE, 
          row.names = 1)

# strange extra column 
scott_RNAseq$X <- NULL

str_count(colnames(scott_RNAseq), "[.]")


colnames(scott_RNAseq) <- matrix(unlist(strsplit(colnames(scott_RNAseq), "[.]")), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)[,2]

scott_time_datasets <- read.table("~/Dropbox/GNP_MB_integrate/2016_06_18_integration/table_2017_12_11/time_series_name.txt", 
                                  sep = "\t", header = FALSE)
scott_time_datasets <- gsub(".*[.]","",scott_time_datasets$V1)




#remove the htseq tail
scott_htseq_tail <- scott_RNAseq[(dim(scott_RNAseq)[1]-4):(dim(scott_RNAseq)[1]),] 
scott_RNAseq <- scott_RNAseq[1:(dim(scott_RNAseq)[1]-5),]
pheatmap(cor(scott_RNAseq, method = "spearman" ))

scott_GNP<- scott_RNAseq[,colnames(scott_RNAseq) %in% scott_time_datasets]
scott_GNP <- scott_GNP[,match(scott_time_datasets, colnames(scott_GNP))]


scott_GNP_meta <- c("E15","E15","E15", "P1", "P1", "P7", "P7", "P7", "P14", "P14", "P14")
scott_GNP_meta <- factor(scott_GNP_meta, levels = c("E15", "P1", "P7", "P14"))


```

```{r rnaseq_rlog, fig.width= 5, fig.heigh = 5}
library(ggplot2)
scott_GNP <- as.matrix(scott_GNP)
colData <- data.frame(cols = colnames(scott_GNP), condition = scott_GNP_meta)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = scott_GNP, colData = colData, design = ~ condition)
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
dds <- estimateDispersions(dds)

scott_GNP_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)

hist(log10(rowMax(scott_GNP_counts)+1), breaks = 100)


pheatmap(cor(scott_GNP_counts))
pheatmap(cor(scott_GNP_counts, method = "spearman"))
dim(scott_GNP_counts)


```

```{r}
  dplyr::left_join(hatten_trap_pval, by = c("ensembl_gene_id" = "ensembl_gene_id")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(scott_gnp_pval, by = c("ensembl_transcript_id" = "ensembl_transcript_id"))



```



```{r}
RNAseq_list <- lapply(RNAseq_list, as.matrix)

# convert all remaining zeroes to lowest real value
min_val <- min(sapply(RNAseq_list, function(x) min(x[x > 0])))
RNAseq_list <- lapply(RNAseq_list, function(x) ifelse(x == 0, min_val, x))
# generate row normalized log2 list
log2_norm_list <- lapply(RNAseq_list, 
                         function(l) log2(sweep(l,1, rowMeans(l), "/")))

average_df  <- function(df, meta) {
  df_avg <- as.data.frame(lapply(levels(meta), 
                                     function(x) {rowMeans(df[,which(meta == x)])}))
  colnames(df_avg) <- levels(meta)
  return(df_avg)
}  

log2_norm_avg_list <- lapply(1:length(log2_norm_list), 
                         function(n) average_df(log2_norm_list[[n]], meta_list[[n]]))

```

## T50 measurement
try to interpolate and calculate time at 50 % max.  single gene code  
```{r}
#library(Hmisc)
library(akima)
#library(fdasrvf)
library(reshape2)
library(stringr)

scott <- log2_norm_avg_list[[1]][1,]
hatten <- log2_norm_avg_list[[2]][1,]

time_ref  <- data.frame( time = c(str_c("E", c(15:20)), str_c("P", c(0:56)))) 

time_ref$scott <- time_ref$time %in% c("E15", "P1", "P7", "P14")
time_ref$hatten <- time_ref$time %in% c("P0","P7","P12","P18","P21","P56")
 
scott_ap <- approx(x =which(time_ref$scott), y = log2_norm_avg_list[[1]][1,], xout = c(1:dim(time_ref)[1]))
hatten_ap <- approx(x =which(time_ref$hatten), y = log2_norm_avg_list[[2]][1,], xout = c(1:dim(time_ref)[1]))

# use the intervening points to set the baseline value for the second data 
ds_ov <- data.frame(time = c(1: length(scott_ap$y[!(is.na(scott_ap$y) | is.na(hatten_ap$y))])),
                    scott = scott_ap$y[!(is.na(scott_ap$y) | is.na(hatten_ap$y))], 
                    hatten = hatten_ap$y[!(is.na(scott_ap$y) | is.na(hatten_ap$y))])

ds_ov$hatten_mod <-ds_ov$hatten  + (median(ds_ov$scott - ds_ov$hatten))
ds_ov_m <- melt(ds_ov, id.vars = "time") 
ggplot(ds_ov_m, aes(x = time, y = value, group = variable, colour = variable)) + geom_line()


ap <- data.frame(i = c(1:dim(time_ref)[1]), time = time_ref$time,  scott = scott_ap$y, hatten = hatten_ap$y )
ap$hatten <- ap$hatten +  (median(ds_ov$scott - ds_ov$hatten))
# now that time series aligned find the common minimum and maximum 
all_min <- min(min(ap$scott, na.rm = TRUE), min(ap$hatten_mod, na.rm = TRUE) )
all_max <- max(max(ap$scott, na.rm = TRUE), max(ap$hatten_mod, na.rm = TRUE))

# shift the data centered upon zero 
ap[,3:ncol(ap)] <- ap[,3:ncol(ap)]  - ((all_max - all_min) / 2)
ap$avg <- apply(ap[,3:ncol(ap)], 1, function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))

# calculate using avg and other datasets 
y0 <- data.frame(y0_avg = min(approx(x = ap$avg, y = ap$i, xout = 0)$y, max(which(!is.na(ap$scott))), na.rm = TRUE), 
            y0_hatten = min(approx(x = ap$hatten, y = ap$i, xout = 0)$y, max(which(!is.na(ap$scott))), na.rm = TRUE), 
            y0_scott = min(approx(x = ap$scott, y = ap$i, xout = 0)$y, max(which(!is.na(ap$scott))), na.rm = TRUE))
row.names(y0) <- "y0"
y0 <- t(y0)
y0 <- as.data.frame(y0)

ap_m <- melt(ap, id.vars = c("time", "i")) 

ggplot(ap_m, aes(x = i, y = value, group = variable, colour = variable)) + geom_line() + 
  geom_vline(data = y0, aes(xintercept = y0) )


```

on all genes 

```{r, fig.height= 8, fig.width= 8, warning = FALSE}

source('~/Dropbox/jp_seq/time_expr_interp.R')
source('~/Dropbox/jp_seq/time_expr_align.R')
source('~/Dropbox/jp_seq/time_expr_avg.R')
source('~/Dropbox/jp_seq/expr_half_max.R')
source("~/Dropbox/jp_seq/expr_half_max_min.R")

row.names(time_ref) <- time_ref$time
time_ref$time <- NULL

log2_norm_avg_list_interp <- time_expr_interp( log2_norm_avg_list, time_ref)
log2_norm_avg_list_interp_align <- time_expr_align(log2_norm_avg_list_interp)

# shift the uninterpolated data
shift <- time_expr_align(log2_norm_avg_list_interp, return_shift = TRUE)


log2_norm_avg_list_shift <-  lapply(c(1:length(log2_norm_avg_list)), function(i) (log2_norm_avg_list[[i]] + shift[,i]))
log2_norm_list_shift <-  lapply(c(1:length(log2_norm_list)), function(i) (log2_norm_list[[i]] + shift[,i]))

log2_norm_avg_list_interp_align_avg <- time_expr_avg(log2_norm_avg_list_interp_align)



total_change <- sapply(log2_norm_avg_list_interp_align, function (j)  apply(j, 1, function(i) max(i, na.rm = TRUE))  - apply(j, 1, function(i) min(i, na.rm = TRUE)))
total_change_avg <-  apply(log2_norm_avg_list_interp_align_avg, 1, function(i) max(i, na.rm = TRUE))  - apply(log2_norm_avg_list_interp_align_avg, 1, function(i) min(i, na.rm = TRUE))

total_change_direction <-  sapply(log2_norm_avg_list_interp_align, function (j)  ifelse(apply(j, 1, function(i) which.max(i))  > apply(j, 1, function(i) which.min(i)), 1, -1))
total_change_direction_avg <- ifelse((apply(log2_norm_avg_list_interp_align_avg, 1, function(i) which.max(i))  > apply(log2_norm_avg_list_interp_align_avg, 1, function(i) which.min(i))), 1, -1)


max_interp <- sapply(log2_norm_avg_list_interp_align, function (j)  apply(j, 1, function(i) which.max(i))) 
max_interp_avg <- apply(log2_norm_avg_list_interp_align_avg, 1, function(i) which.max(i)) 
min_interp <- sapply(log2_norm_avg_list_interp_align, function (j)  apply(j, 1, function(i) which.min(i))) 
min_interp_avg <- apply(log2_norm_avg_list_interp_align_avg, 1, function(i) which.min(i)) 

total_change <- cbind(total_change,total_change_avg)
colnames(total_change) <- c("scott_fc", "hatten_fc", "avg_fc") 

total_change_direction <- cbind(total_change_direction, total_change_direction_avg)
colnames(total_change_direction) <- c("scott_dir", "hatten_dir", "avg_dir") 

max_min_interp <- cbind(min_interp, min_interp_avg, max_interp, max_interp_avg)
colnames(max_min_interp) <- c("scott_min", "hatten_min", "avg_min", "scott_max", "hatten_max", "avg_max") 

expr <- as.data.frame(expr_half_max(log2_norm_avg_list_interp_align))
expr$avg <- expr_half_max(log2_norm_avg_list_interp_align_avg)


t50_up_down <-  expr_half_max_min(log2_norm_avg_list_interp_align_avg)

 
colnames(expr) <- c("scott_t50", "hatten_t50", "avg_t50") 
expr <- cbind(expr, total_change, total_change_direction, max_min_interp)

row.names(toc) <- toc$Symbol
table(row.names(toc) == row.names(expr))




```

# How many genes increase with differentiation

```{r}
library(parallel)
library(GGally)
table(toc_t50[toc_t50$avg_fc >= 1 | (toc_t50$hatten_trap_min_pval <= p_val_cutoff & toc_t50$scott_gnp_min_pval <=  p_val_cutoff),"max_t50_cat"])


# Calculate the number of cores
no_cores <- detectCores() - 1
 
# Initiate cluster
cl <- makeCluster(no_cores)

group_genes_txchange <- function (df, fc_cutoff, p_val_cutoff, expr_scott_cutoff, expr_hatten_cutoff, 
                                  table_only = FALSE, pval_both = FALSE) {
  new_df <- df
  new_df$max_cat <- cut(df$avg_max, c(0,2,20,64), right=FALSE, labels=c("E15", "P0_7", "P14_P56"))
  new_df$t50_cat <- cut(df$avg_t50, c(0,6,18,64), right=FALSE, labels=c("Early", "Mid", "Late"))
  new_df$max_t50_cat <- str_c("Max_",new_df$max_cat, " ","t50_", new_df$t50_cat )
  new_df$max_cat <- factor(new_df$max_cat)
  new_df$max_t50_cat <- factor(new_df$max_t50_cat)
  # preset the factor levels so that table does miss the levels
  new_df$max_cat <- factor(new_df$max_cat, levels = c(levels(new_df$max_cat), "unchanged", "unexpressed"))
  new_df$max_t50_cat <- factor(new_df$max_t50_cat, levels = c(levels(new_df$max_t50_cat), "unchanged", "unexpressed"))
  
  # modify the groups based upon fc and pval 
  if (pval_both) {
  new_df$max_cat[df$avg_fc < fc_cutoff |  
                   (df$hatten_trap_min_pval > p_val_cutoff | 
                      df$scott_gnp_min_pval >  p_val_cutoff)] <- "unchanged" 
  
  new_df$max_t50_cat[df$avg_fc < fc_cutoff |  
                       (df$hatten_trap_min_pval > p_val_cutoff | 
                          df$scott_gnp_min_pval >  p_val_cutoff)] <- "unchanged" 
  } else {
  new_df$max_cat[df$avg_fc < fc_cutoff |  
                   (df$hatten_trap_min_pval > p_val_cutoff & 
                      df$scott_gnp_min_pval >  p_val_cutoff)] <- "unchanged" 
  
  new_df$max_t50_cat[df$avg_fc < fc_cutoff |  
                       (df$hatten_trap_min_pval > p_val_cutoff & 
                          df$scott_gnp_min_pval >  p_val_cutoff)] <- "unchanged"   
    
  }
  
  new_df$max_cat[df$max_expr_Scott < expr_scott_cutoff & df$max_expr_Hatten < expr_hatten_cutoff] <-  "unexpressed"
  new_df$max_t50_cat[df$max_expr_Scott < expr_scott_cutoff & df$max_expr_Hatten < expr_hatten_cutoff] <- "unexpressed"
  

  if (table_only) {
    cat_tab <- tabulate(new_df$max_t50_cat, nbins = 11)
    cat_tab <- as.vector(cat_tab)
    names(cat_tab) <- levels(new_df$max_t50_cat)
    return(cat_tab)
  } else {
    return(new_df)
  }
}
  
group_genes_txchange(toc_t50, 1, p_val_cutoff, 100, 100, table_only = TRUE) 
group_genes_txchange(toc_t50, 1.5, p_val_cutoff, 100, 100, table_only = TRUE) 
group_genes_txchange(toc_t50, 2, p_val_cutoff, 100, 100, table_only = TRUE) 

group_genes_txchange(toc_t50, 1, p_val_cutoff, 100, 100, table_only = TRUE, pval_both = TRUE) 
group_genes_txchange(toc_t50, 1.5, p_val_cutoff, 100, 100, table_only = TRUE, pval_both = TRUE)  
group_genes_txchange(toc_t50, 2, p_val_cutoff, 100, 100, table_only = TRUE, pval_both = TRUE)  

gene_num_param <- expand.grid(fc = seq(from = 1, to = 10, by = 1), 
                              p_val_cutoff = c(10^(-2:-10)), 
                              expr_scott_cutoff =  seq(from = 0, to = 300, by = 50),  
                              expr_hatten_cutoff = seq(from = 0, to = 300, by = 50))

gene_num <- mcmapply(function(fc_cut, p_val_cut, expr_scott_cut, expr_hatten_cut) group_genes_txchange(toc_t50, fc_cut, p_val_cut, expr_scott_cut, expr_hatten_cut, table_only = TRUE), gene_num_param$fc, gene_num_param$p_val_cutoff, gene_num_param$expr_scott_cutoff, gene_num_param$expr_hatten_cutoff,  mc.cores = 6)

gene_num <- t(gene_num)

max_late_t50_mid <- gene_num_param
gene_num <- as.data.frame(gene_num)
max_late_t50_mid$gene_num <- gene_num$`Max_P14_P56 t50_Late` + gene_num$`Max_P14_P56 t50_Mid`
```
